### The Goal of Christ’s Love
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-goal-of-christs-love
Passage: John 17:24
Points:
- God deeply cherishes His people, but He will not allow that preciousness to replace worshiping Him.
- True Christian joy is not merely reveling in being loved, but being captivated by who Christ is.
- Saving acts like forgiveness, propitiation, and reconciliation serve the greater purpose of bringing believers into Jesus' presence.
- The ultimate goal of Christ's love is for His people to behold and savor His glory forever.

### What Manner of Love
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-30-2026.html
Passage: John 17:23
Points:
- Jesus reveals the astonishing reality that the Father loves believers with the very same love He has for His Son.
- This divine love is so colossal and stupendous that human language struggles to adequately describe it.
- Believers can find profound peace and assurance knowing they are held secure in God's sovereign, fatherly love.
